d47df7f2decc0cd93f27deb58cc21c3071c9fcb8.summary: A Natto Team Substack post, first published 2024-09-04 with a June 2026 note, on reconnaissance scanning tools used by Chinese threat actors and similar open-source tools. The note says 2026 reports describe China-nexus APT groups, including Volt Typhoon, industrialising reconnaissance. It cites a Black Lotus Labs report on June 10, 2026 about the JDY botnet. The text is truncated behind a paywall.

d4ce223008301f9d38aed51494c1d8787f9edbd5.summary: A GitHub code repository page for a PHP server emulator, described as a tool for SHATTEREDGLASS ransomware attributed to Andariel. The page gives only a one-line description, a list of external sources, and repository metadata. It contains no threat analysis, so it is recorded as not a threat report and the fact lists are empty.

d4eeb21e1531c151f318541d048c1b980fa857a8.summary: Article published 2023-01-18 by The Record, reporting Microsoft's statement that nation-state groups from China, Iran, North Korea and Turkey are abusing the Log4Shell vulnerability to reach targeted networks. Named actors are PHOSPHORUS (Iran, deploying ransomware) and HAFNIUM (China, targeting virtualization infrastructure). Microsoft also observed initial access brokers selling footholds to ransomware gangs. A first ransomware operation, Khonsari, was spotted on a Sunday. Over 60 exploit variations were seen in the wild, with links to DDoS botnets, crypto-mining and StealthLoader. The CVE…
